content.title: About
content.content: NFS potato chips are thinly sliced potato pieces that are fried until crisp and seasoned with salt and spices. The product is made from selected potatoes that are peeled, sliced, washed, dried and quickly fried in vegetable oil at high temperature.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first commercial chip brand appeared in the USA in 1853, and NFS is one of the most popular brands in Russia.
NFS chips are available in several flavors: classic, barbecue, sour cream & onion, etc.
To achieve a crunchy texture the potatoes are blanched beforehand, reducing acrylamide formation.
The packaging is multi‑layered to keep the chips crisp and protect them from moisture.
A standard serving (30 g) provides about 150 kcal.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Potato chips contain carbohydrates that quickly supply energy.

items.title: Vitamin C content
items.content: A small amount of vitamin C is retained during rapid frying, supporting the immune system.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: Potatoes are rich in potassium, important for fluid balance and muscle function.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: A modest amount of fiber contributes to digestive health.

items.title: Pleasurable taste
items.content: The crunch and aroma can improve mood and satisfy snack cravings.

items.title: High salt content
items.content: Chips often contain a lot of sodium, which may raise blood pressure if consumed in excess.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Because of their fat and carbohydrate content, chips are calorie‑dense and can contribute to weight gain.

items.title: Trans fats and acrylamide
items.content: Frying can produce small amounts of trans fats and acrylamide, compounds with potential health concerns.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: Rarely, some individuals may be allergic to potatoes or to seasoning additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: NFS chips are convenient as a standalone snack, can be added to salads, used in dishes for crunch, and served with dips and sauces.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store chips in the original package or an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, consume within 1–2 weeks to maintain crispness.
